actual: A single gh pr view or gh pr checks GraphQL EOF/TLS error blocks the merge workflow and requires another window or manual retry.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: A single gh pr view or gh pr checks GraphQL EOF/TLS error blocks the merge workflow and requires another window or manual retry.
evidence_uris: 638 workflow event files: 25 GraphQL EOF and 6 TLS handshake timeouts; BUG-1085 only covers the merge mutation path
expected: Transport-only failures in merge-critical GraphQL reads recover through bounded retries and REST readback while genuine PR, CI, conflict, permission, or policy failures remain blocking.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
reproduce_command: Simulate gh pr view and gh pr checks returning GraphQL EOF while the REST PR, protection, check-run, and status endpoints report the pinned head and required CI success.
title: Merge-critical GitHub reads block on GraphQL transport failures without REST fallback
